messages:
alejandra: Quick heads-up — planning a blue->green traffic shift for the router at 2026-06-15 23:00 UTC (change window 23:00-00:30). Release bundle v3.4 will be live on green. Need LB/router ops and oncall aware. I'll start gradual splits and hold at each step for at least 3 minutes.
sam: ETA on the first cut? will we do canary 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100%?
alejandra: yes, plan is 5% / 20% / 50% / 100% with health checks and perf gates at each step. abort if 5xx > 0.5% or p95 latency > baseline + 120ms.
ryan: Sticky session note — legacy cookie `rw-session` can pin to old pool. we should add a route rule to honor `rw-model-version` header for pinned sessions. otherwise some users might get inconsistent model versions.
mira: Confirming runbook: rollback is immediate weight reset back to blue + config pin for 30m, then analyze. Also we'll mark the deploy with `release/3.4` in audit logs.
deploy-bot: Deploy started: release/3.4 -> green cluster. Initiated by alejandra at 2026-06-15T23:00:05Z.
priyanka: For the router change, I'll push the LB canary via `api-router` endpoint. Example request:
```
curl -X POST https://router-api.prod/internal/shifts \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ROUTER_API' \
  -d '{"target":"green","weights":[5,20,50,100],"hold_seconds":180}'
```
ryan: Also adding this haproxy tweak for session affinity (backend `rw-green`):
```
backend rw-green
  cookie JSESSIONID prefix
  stick-table type ip size 200k expire 30m
  stick on src
```
sam: Can we lock model version for dedicated customers? we should ensure `X-Model-Version` header honored; else pin via LB rule for `account=enterprise-123`.
alejandra: yes — we'll add a config override for enterprise accounts before the 50% step.
oncall-bot: PagerDuty: oncall rotation notice — mira is oncall for 2026-06-15 22:00 -> 2026-06-16 06:00.
mira: I'll watch metrics and be ready to execute rollback. please @mention me if you trigger the abort gate.
deploy-bot: Traffic update: green=5%, blue=95% (timestamp 2026-06-15T23:02:12Z). All health checks OK.
sam: initial metrics look clean (no 5xx spikes). proceeding to 20% in 3m.
deploy-bot: Traffic update: green=20%, blue=80% (timestamp 2026-06-15T23:05:30Z). Observability: p95 +40ms, error 0.12%.
alejandra: good. reminding: if errors >0.5% abort. continue to 50% after 6m.
priyanka: Pinned enterprise customers (enterprise-123, enterprise-79) remain on blue via header rule.
deploy-bot: Traffic update: green=50%, blue=50% (timestamp 2026-06-15T23:12:01Z). p95 +55ms, errors 0.18%.
ryan: seeing slight KV cache miss increase — expected. recommending bump cache warmup TTLs for green for next deploy.
mira: I'm seeing a transient 502 spike for one AZ at 23:12:30; looks like a router connection timeout. I've paged infra to investigate but global metrics are within gate.
alejandra: hold at 50% for 10m. if AZ spike resolves, proceed. if recurrence >2 events in 10m, rollback.
deploy-bot: Traffic update: green=100%, blue=0% (timestamp 2026-06-15T23:24:45Z). Deploy complete.
sam: verifying release notes and tagging commit. also pin rolling config in case we need to fallback quickly.
mira: no active alerts now. I'll keep monitoring for 30m and then sign off.
alejandra: thanks team. postmortem checklist: capture timeout trace, update perf baseline, follow up on cache warmup. tagging ops and eng-platform.
priyanka: added change window note and release notes link: https://redwood/internal/releases/3.4
ryan: created a quick PR for TTL bump: internal/infra#482 — please review tomorrow.
oncall-bot: Reminder: Schedule handoff for next oncall in 00:45.
alejandra: closing this thread; if anything unexpected pops, re-open here or ping @mira. :tada:
